hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.venv/bin/ruff format "$f" && ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.venv/bin/ruff check --fix "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Running ruff on changed Python file...

hooks.command: cd ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} && files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.py$' || true); if [ -n "$files" ]; then echo "$files" | xargs ./.venv/bin/ruff format && echo "$files" | xargs git add; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Formatting staged Python files before commit...

hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Task complete" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null || notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Task complete' 2>/dev/null || true
